visualCharacteristics.layout: Lightweight grid of press photos (3 per row on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile); each item: uncropped product photo with a short caption underneath and an optional link to the hi-res original (the photo itself also links to the original). Options: 'four-up' (4 per row from 900px), 'slider' (one horizontal scroll-snap row, 1/2/3/4 visible at <600/600/900/1200px, photos cropped to 4:3, prev/next buttons hidden when everything fits)

contentPattern: One row per photo: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = caption paragraph plus optional link to the hi-res original (e.g. a cdn.continental.com/fileadmin/... URL, link text 'Download' or the caption itself)
